Name: Stardew Valley Bilingual Text
Author: MinamiEki
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Displays nearly all text in Stardew Valley in a bilingual format (e.g. English / Chinese side by side). Supports language pairs en-zh, de-en, ja-zh, and off. Switch languages in real time via GMCM — no restart needed. Built purely with Content Patcher, no game code modification.
在星露谷物语中实现双语显示（如英文 / 中文 并列显示）。支持 en-zh、de-en、ja-zh、off 四种模式，通过 GMCM 实时切换，无需重启。纯 Content Patcher 实现，不修改游戏代码。
GitHub: https://github.com/QingGo/stardew-biling-mod[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Install SMAPI 4.0+ (smapi.io), Content Patcher 2.0+ (Nexus #1915), and optionally GMCM 1.16+ (Nexus #5098)
Download the latest release from Nexus or GitHub
Extract and copy the BilingualMod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods/
Launch via StardewModdingAPI.exe, set game language to Chinese on the title screen
Open GMCM → "Stardew Valley Bilingual Text" → set BilingualMode to en-zh, de-en, ja-zh, or off
To update: delete the old BilingualMod folder completely, then extract the new one

安装 SMAPI 4.0+ (smapi.io)、Content Patcher 2.0+ (Nexus #1915)，可选安装 GMCM 1.16+ (Nexus #5098)
从 Nexus 或 GitHub 下载最新版本
解压后将 BilingualMod 文件夹复制到 Stardew Valley/Mods/
通过 StardewModdingAPI.exe 启动，在主界面将游戏语言设为 中文
打开 GMCM → "Stardew Valley Bilingual Text" → 将 BilingualMode 设为 en-zh、de-en、ja-zh 或 off
更新时请先删除旧的 BilingualMod 文件夹，再解压新版本

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]- Side-by-side bilingual text for nearly all in-game text (dialogues, events, items, UI, mail, TV, festivals, schedules, etc.)
- Three language pairs: English + Chinese, German + English, Japanese + Chinese
- Real-time switching via GMCM config menu — no game restart required
- Zero game code modification — pure Content Patcher content pack
- Cross-CJK font merging (Japanese + Chinese glyphs in both directions)
- ~185 Content Patcher patches covering 30+ string assets, 48 dialogue assets, 43 event assets, and 800+ items

- 几乎所有游戏内文本的双语并列显示（对话、事件、物品、UI、邮件、电视、节日、日程等）
- 三种语言配对：英中、德英、日中
- 通过 GMCM 实时切换模式，无需重启游戏
- 零游戏代码修改 — 纯 Content Patcher 内容包
- 跨中日韩字体合并（日语 + 中文字形双向支持）
- 约 185 个 CP 补丁，覆盖 30+ 字符串资源、48 个对话资源、43 个事件资源、800+ 物品[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]-Stardew Valley 1.6+ (must include Chinese language pack)
-SMAPI 4.0+
-Content Patcher 2.0+ (Nexus #1915)
-Generic Mod Config Menu 1.16+ (Nexus #5098) — optional but strongly recommended for in-game config[/color]
